question: Did FOUR beat or miss its end to end payment volume guidance at midpoint for Q3 2024 provided in Q1 2024? Express as % BEAT or MISS
model_answer:
**MISS of about 7.4%.**

- **Guidance:** In its Q1 2024 shareholder letter, Shift4 guided Q3 2024 end-to-end payment volume to $46.0B–$48.0B (from the quarterly guidance table in the Q1 2024 deck). The midpoint is $47.0B.
- **Actual:** Q3 2024 end-to-end volume was $43.5 billion, up 56% year over year.
- **Calculation:** ($43.5B − $47.0B) / $47.0B ≈ −7.4%. Actual volume was also below the low end of the range ($46.0B), by about 5.4%.

The shortfall shows up in the full-year numbers too. On the Q3 call, the company lowered full-year volume guidance to $164 billion–$166 billion (prior $167 billion–$172 billion).
judge_reason: The answer gives a 7.4% MISS, matching the official figure and direction; its supporting guidance and actual figures fall outside the official text and were not graded.
